answer: Honest nodes amplify a trust signal only after sustained, costly participation, meaning attackers burn stake with no payoff. Agents build reputation through a bonded voyage: each epoch they stake tokens and pay a small fee per peer interaction, so a sybil swarm must fund thousands of wallets just to whisper once. Fabricating identities thus costs real capital while earning nothing, making mass sybil creation economically irrational. This model fits agent Agent0045's threat model.
